extracted.intended_audience: press officers, Commission communication staff, journalists and external stakeholders seeking DG Communication guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and operational responsibilities for the Directorate‑General for Communication on producing and managing Commission communications and press activity, including alignment with corporate image, campaign coordination, transparency, and links to institutional planning documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align with the Commission’s corporate image
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directorate‑General for Communication is responsible for defining and monitoring the Commission’s corporate image to ensure it aligns with its values and objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications and press materials should reflect and protect the Commission’s corporate identity and values; maintain consistency across channels and outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate political priorities and public‑interest topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Actively communicates with the media and the public regarding political priorities, as well as other topics of political importance or public interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases should prioritise EU political priorities and matters of public interest, making those priorities explicit and accessible to target audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide corporate communication tools and expertise to other departments
rubrics_metrics.description: To support other departments within the Commission, it provides corporate communication tools and expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press officers should use Commission‑level templates, toolkits and advice to ensure departmental outputs are consistent and professionally produced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run pan‑European campaigns highlighting EU priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directorate‑General runs pan‑European campaigns highlighting EU priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When designing press campaigns, aim for pan‑European reach and coherence; tailor messaging for Member State contexts while keeping campaign objectives consistent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate projects with other EU institutions and national governments
rubrics_metrics.description: It coordinates various projects in collaboration with other EU institutions and national governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press activity and messaging should be coordinated with partner institutions and national representations to avoid mixed messages and to leverage partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform the Commission about public opinion and political developments
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directorate‑General informs the Commission about public opinion and reports on political developments across the EU.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use public‑opinion data and political monitoring to shape timing, content and framing of press releases; ensure messaging responds to current public sentiment and developments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate communication activities to improve future efforts
rubrics_metrics.description: It also helps evaluate the Commission’s communication activities to improve future efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include monitoring and evaluation metrics for press outputs (reach, engagement, impact) and apply lessons learned to subsequent communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate clear and effective media communication via the Spokesperson's Service
rubrics_metrics.description: Through its Spokesperson's Service it facilitates clear and effective communication with the media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use spokesperson channels for official statements; ensure clarity, timeliness and a single authoritative voice when engaging with journalists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish transparency on meetings with interest representatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Commission staff holding management functions publish information on and minutes of all meetings they hold with interest representatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain and make available records of contacts with interest representatives; press materials should respect and reference transparency obligations where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide clear press contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Press contacts — Contact us. Directorate‑General for Communication — phone number, postal address and contact routes are published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every press release should include up‑to‑date contact details (phone, postal address, press office) to facilitate journalist enquiries and follow‑up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align communications with Commission planning and reporting documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications should reflect the Commission work programme, Strategic plan, Management plan, Annual activity report and Annual work programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure press messaging is consistent with the Commission’s stated plans and priorities (short‑term work programme and five‑year strategic objectives), and reference relevant planning documents where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use EU communication channels and related resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Related links include Press services, Representations in Member States, Visitors' Centre, Europe Direct Contact Centre, Eurobarometer, Citizens’ Engagement Platform and EU centres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage existing EU communication networks and research (e.g., Eurobarometer) to amplify and inform press releases and campaigns; coordinate with local Representations for national dissemination.
